name: Everywhere Ventures
thesis: Pre-seed investor backing purpose-driven founders from anywhere in the world, focused on the future of money, health and work: fintech, digital health and new ways of working.

name: Plug and Play
thesis: Pre-seed to Series A investor in enterprise and B2B SaaS, with a focus on AI applications and enterprise infrastructure.

name: Wischoff Ventures
thesis: Pre-seed and seed investor digitizing offline industries: logistics and supply chain, construction and manufacturing, payments and vertical software that bring physical-industry operations online.

name: Forum Ventures
thesis: Pre-seed fund and accelerator for B2B software founders, industry-agnostic but leaning toward vertical SaaS, vertical AI, AI infrastructure, fintech, healthcare and supply chain, with a strong go-to-market focus.

name: Seed B2B software
thesis: Seed-stage B2B software: technical founders building products that businesses pay for, such as developer tools, security, AI infrastructure and workflow automation, with a small team and early traction.
